responsibility: Contains the RL78 machine-description expanders that lower generic GCC RTL operations into RL78-specific forms before final instruction matching. It handles front-end expansion choices for moves, extensions, arithmetic, shifts, calls, indirect jumps, and conditional branches, including forcing memory-to-memory and far-memory cases through temporary registers, rejecting unsupported symbol/subreg forms, splitting wider moves, and delegating compare expansion and nonfar normalization to backend helper routines in rl78.cc.
